explanation: Bound each component of the actual constructor by the common envelope. This common-envelope estimate supplies a polynomial bound for the full executed local-cover construction time.
theorem_title: A polynomial envelope for local-cover construction time
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverCost.build_time_bound {h B : ℕ}
    (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hL : 464*h+1 ≤ B) (hn : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverLayout.vertices h+1 ≤ B)
    (hp : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LocalCoverBounds.localPrime h+1 ≤ B) (hN : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverSchedule.rows h+1 ≤ B) (hT : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.GlobalEncoding.scheduleSize h+1 ≤ B) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightLocalCoverBuild.time h ≤ 10000*B^5 := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
If $B\ge1$ bounds, with one-cell slack, the width $464h$, vertex count, local prime, candidate-row count, and schedule size, then $$\operatorname{buildTime}(h)\le10000B^5.$$

This common-envelope estimate supplies a polynomial bound for the full executed local-cover construction time.
